name: 弗朗西斯·柯林斯
bio_short: 美国遗传学家和医生，曾任美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）院长。他领导了公立的“人类基因组计划”（`human_genome_project_2003`），成功完成了人类DNA序列的测绘，被誉为“基因组时代的掌舵人”。
bio_short_en: An American geneticist and physician, and former Director of the NIH. He led the public 'Human Genome Project' (`human_genome_project_2003`), successfully mapping the human DNA sequence, and is regarded as the 'Helmsman of the Genomic Era'.
